data.name: Just a stroll in the forest
data.detailed_description:
A weekend getaway. A harmless treasure hunt. A desperate rescue mission.

You arrive at the dense, suffocating edge of the woods expecting a cheerful reunion with your girlfriend, Steph, who went missing during a girls' weekend trip. Instead, you find an abandoned campsite, scattered gear, and a trail of frantic notes.

The "treasure hunt" Steph and her friends were following wasn't a game at all. It was a trap.

They unlocked something ancient. Now, they are trapped in a living nightmare, and the clock is ticking. To save Steph and escape with your lives, you must piece together the clues of a ritual gone horribly wrong.

The rules of the forest are simple but cruel: Gather the stolen gems. Return them to the cursed, gold-laden coffin. Or become a permanent part of the woods.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Explore a beautifully eerie, Unreal Engine-powered forest where the shadows stretch and every snapping twig could mean your demise.

  • Piecing Together the Mystery: Discover letters, and your own characters audio/narrative to reconstruct the final hours of the girls' weekend and find Steph’s location.

  • High-Stakes Relic Hunting: Track down the scattered gems hidden across haunted landmarks, all while keeping your wits about you when you first hear the creatures.

  • The Cursed Coffin: Your only safe haven—and your ultimate objective. Get the 8 gems that are scattered around the forest and escape. 

  • Immersive Survival: No heavy weaponry, just your wits, a flashlight, and the desperate drive to save the woman you love.

Will you break the curse, or will you take their place in the coffin?

data.short_description: Your girlfriend went missing during a weekend treasure hunt. Arriving at her location, you discover the "game" was a trap. To save her, you must find the scattered gems and return them to a cursed, gold-filled coffin—before the forest traps you both forever. An atmospheric survival mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz quad-core processor (Intel or AMD)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Game was created using Unreal 4.27, which allows for scaling typically. I hope that you can play it on many PC.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: SSD Not Required but would assist with load times
